failures.detail: INIT-006: Phase moves backward from "complete" to "construction-active", and Status stays "passed" even though the new C116 note says no construction milestone is certified, so the row's status and notes tell different stories.
INIT-014: Phase moves backward from "vote-scheduled" to "announced" with no recorded event explaining the regression, while the note now treats the prior C115 filing claim as unverified.

INIT-003: ImplementationPhase remains "complete" while the notes say further design advancement is held pending schematics and a Fruitvale comment-and-response record, so the phase and milestone notes contradict each other.
